summary: The StudentQualifications control is a user interface component for managing and displaying student qualifications within a web application. It allows for adding, editing, and deleting qualifications associated with a student. The control interacts with the ObjectDataSource components for data operations and uses GridView for displaying data. It includes functionality for handling user sessions and utilizes ASP.NET web forms components.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing student qualifications, allowing users to view, add, edit, or delete qualifications associated with a student.

workflows.name: Managing Student Qualifications
steps: Select qualifications data with session and student ID.
Bind GridView with data and set up add/edit/delete buttons based on permissions.
Handle row commands for adding, editing, and deleting qualifications.
Handle inserting and updating items with proper validations.

business_rules: Cancel operation if user session is not valid.
Set input parameters for data operations based on user session and student ID.
validations: Cancel operation if the page is not valid during inserting or updating.
Select values from dropdowns for fields qualificationCodeID, authorityCodeID, and countryCodeID.
conditions: Check if the screen is editable to determine visibility of buttons.
Handle row types in GridView for setting up buttons.
system_behavior: Data is bound to controls and operations are performed based on session validity.
Grid data is processed for displaying messages and handling no data scenarios.
Details are shown or hidden in modals based on user actions and command types.
